subject: general
question: Hafiz Ali Khan was an Indian __________ player of the Bangash gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sarod.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Hafiz Ali Khan (1888–1972) was an Indian **sarod player**.
 
• A fifth-generation descendant of the **Bangash Gharana (school or style) of sarod players.**
 
• Hafiz Ali was known for the** lyrical beauty** of his music and the** crystal-clear tone** of his strokes.
 
• The sarod is **an adaptation of the Afghan rabab**, which arrived in India during the 16th century.
 
• The modern form of the instrument was** designed in the 19th century.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8a0c068c0f65721603c56713f00c679532a719962d3b5f171a41f293309f0e4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**S****arangi**, also called saran or saranga, **short-necked fiddle used throughout South Asia, particularly for folk and classical Hindustani music**.
 
• **The flute** is a family of classical music instruments in the woodwind group. 
 
• The Indian santoor instrument is **a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer and a variation of the Iranian Santur**.
